info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening Catalog API
Returns a list of all reward items for a given catalog.

params.name: program_id
params.description: Unique identifier of a rewards program.

params.name: catalog_id
params.description: The internal Mastercard Catalog Hierarchy ID for the rewards program.

params.name: language
params.description: Language for the requested information. Customer preferred language code. This must be a valid language code that is configured for Mastercard program. This field is optional and will return English (en_US), if not specified.

params.name: min_points
params.description: Minimum point value for a reward item.

params.name: max_points
params.description: Maximum point value for a reward item.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Filters reward items based on the keywords provided.

params.name: product_code
params.description: The reward product identifier for the associated account, as defined by the client and configured during the implementation of the program.

items.docs: Returns a list of all reward items for a given catalog and search criteria.
